newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyotaru says to start court-guided restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Kyotaru says to start court-guided restructuring.

text.p: A formal decision to start the financial rehabilitation of sushi restaurant chain Kyotaru Co Ltd was taken by the Tokyo District Court on Monday, Kyotaru said in a statement.
The Tokyo District named the president of frozen-food producer Katokichi Katokichi Co Ltd, Yoshikazu Kato, as an administrator of Kyotaru's assets, Kyotaru said.
This means Katokichi will supervise Kyotaru's rehabilitation and may give necessary assistance, it said.

Kyotaru sought protection from creditors under Japan's bankruptcy laws in January in order to restructure its operations. It made the insolvency filing with debts of 101.3 billion yen, far exceeding its assets of 62.26 billion yen.
Kyotaru was the first firm listed on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange to fail since mid-1993.
It buckled under the weight of debts resulting from rapid domestic expansion and investment in the United States during Japan's 1980s "bubble" of soaring asset prices and unbridled consumption.
On Monday, shares in Kyotaru rose one 1 yen to 29 yen.
